descriptions: Added shared database tables (Config.Base) so multiple tablet resources can run side by side and sync selected data between factions
Added a dedicated keybind (QuickOpen) to open the MDT straight on the Dispatch tab
Added a fine details modal to preview all charges of a multi-item fine
Fine drafts now persist when the MDT is closed and reopened
Fixed a pedheadshot slot leak that caused mugshots to fail after repeated use
Synchronized new translation keys across all 9 supported languages
